summary: Stage holding app files

name: SP_ACCESS_SNAPSHOT
summary: Owner's-rights Python procedure filling the 9 TBL_ACCESS_ data tables from ACCOUNT_USAGE or the SHOW fallback; run() skips if RUNNING. Every statement carries STATEMENT_TIMEOUT (TIMED, sql/1_setup.sql:212-217); SHOW / fallback statements run as async child jobs BATCH (16) at a time (many), heavy INSERTs at most WORKERS at once (later); ACCESS_HISTORY read once for object use + activity (history);

name: Login over PrivateLink
summary: Keep SNOWFLAKE_ACCOUNT=<org>-<account>, set SNOWFLAKE_HOST=<org>-<account>.privatelink + Snowflake domain (regionless-privatelink-account-url from SYSTEM$GET_PRIVATELINK_CONFIG); private DNS for that host and the OCSP host; key pair as is; SSO needs SAML2_SNOWFLAKE_ACS_URL / SAML2_SNOWFLAKE_ISSUER_URL on PrivateLink URLs; not needed inside Snowflake. sf.connect passes host= (sf.py:29)

name: !define STREAMLIT_APP
summary: Name of the Streamlit app inside Snowflake, default ST_ACCESS_EXPLORER: CREATE / GRANT / DROP / SHOW STREAMLIT (sql/4_streamlit.sql:65, 83, sql/3_cleanup.sql:12, verify files) and APP_ST in SP_ACCESS_SNAPSHOT (sql/1_setup.sql:211); letters, digits, - and _ only (run_sql.py:26-28)

name: !define QUERY_TAG
summary: Query tag of the local app, default access-explorer: QUERY_TAG in SP_ACCESS_SNAPSHOT (sql/1_setup.sql:210), so the procedure leaves the local app's queries out; must match QUERY_TAG in .env and sis/.env; letters, digits, - and _ only (run_sql.py:26-28)

name: SNOWFLAKE_HOST
summary: env SNOWFLAKE_HOST, unset by default: host the connector uses instead of the public <account>.snowflakecomputing.com; the PrivateLink host <org>-<account>.privatelink + Snowflake domain (README.md:217, .env.example:36-37)

name: STATEMENT_TIMEOUT (settings.sql)
summary: !define STATEMENT_TIMEOUT=300: seconds each statement of SP_ACCESS_SNAPSHOT may run (TIMEOUT, sql/1_setup.sql:212), 0 = Snowflake's own

name: WORKERS (settings.sql)
summary: !define WORKERS=3: heavy INSERT ... SELECT jobs of SP_ACCESS_SNAPSHOT at once (later(), sql/1_setup.sql:213)

name: ACTIVITY (settings.sql)
summary: !define ACTIVITY=1: 0 = SP_ACCESS_SNAPSHOT reads no ACCESS_HISTORY (READ_ACTIVITY, sql/1_setup.sql:214, 854)

name: test_missing_names
summary: A grant or user-role row without a name is left out with a missing_names note, never a crash in a sort; build() marks the data set with _tidy == tidy_stamp(), and tidy() on a marked set skips the scan (a None row appended afterwards stays)

name: test_empty_reads
summary: Unreadable or odd data: empty results plus a note, never a crash, and never kept as if it were read (no-run read not on disk)

name: test_none_fuzz
summary: Fuzz (none_variants): missing, NULL or empty data gives empty results plus a note, never an exception; a failed build never counts as built for its key

name: test_duck_reach
summary: duck() answers who loses access (lose_all) and the rule 17 / 23 pre-filter (read_shares) exactly as the Python walk, on fake data and big(); a loop falls back to Python

name: test_pages_empty
summary: Every page and CSV, shared and mine, on missing / NULL / empty data answers empty plus a note, never a 500

name: test_background
summary: Read Snowflake again runs in a thread: pages keep the old data and answer at once until the new read is built, then switch; a failed read keeps the old data and says why in /api/progress job

name: test_kept_rules
summary: After a restart the rule results come from .cache/<key>.rules.pkl while data, settings and access.py are the same; another setting checks them again

name: test_parts
summary: Every read kept as a part: the next load reads only the part that timed out, --build reads nothing, --export --fresh reads every part; run.py passes the stage flags

name: app.test.tsx
summary: vitest "App shell during a load": no SQL buttons before data, the first load makes the page inert; Read Snowflake again in the background keeps the page usable, shows the latest line, then the new data

name: nulls.test.tsx
summary: vitest "null and empty data": short() shows a dash, DayStack draws nothing without a first day, Activity tab draws with null names / times and says there is no activity without a first day

name: test_newer_run
summary: Objects mode with parts: the last OK run is asked every load, never kept as a part, so a newer snapshot run shows; an unchanged run reads no table again (Read Snowflake again too)
